faq.a: Forest Ridge at 14588 McDougall Drive, 3535 146A Street and 3585 146A Street was built About 2020 by Quadra Homes, per the MLS® strata building record.
Forest Ridge is 5 (three buildings) storeys with 177 homes.

faq.q: What amenities does Forest Ridge have?
faq.a: A guest suite; ask the strata for the full list.

faq.q: Has Jared sold homes at Forest Ridge?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons has listed and sold homes at Forest Ridge and has helped buyers purchase here. Call or text 604-928-1361 for the recent sold prices in the building.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings of any listing in the building. Call or text 604-928-1361 or email jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca.

Jared has listed and sold homes at Forest Ridge, and has helped buyers purchase here. If you own here, he knows what buyers in this building pay for, and he can show you the recent sold prices before you decide. Call or text 604-928-1361.

Before you buy at Forest Ridge

items.t: the Form B, two years of minutes, the bylaws, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show what Forest Ridge owners are planning to fix and pay for.
since November 24, 2022, BC stratas cannot ban owners from renting, except in age-restricted buildings. Short-term rental limits can still apply.
pet limits, parking stalls, storage lockers and electric car charging are set by the bylaws and the title, home by home. Check them for the exact home you are buying.
